modalities.evidence: 200 MIMIC-III admission notes with adjudicated labels

output.population: Patients with admission notes extracted from MIMIC-III, who stayed in critical care units at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center between 2001 and 2012.
output.summary: 200 MIMIC-III admission notes manually annotated for histories of immunosuppressive conditions and use of immunosuppressive medications, supporting phenotyping of a patient's immune status from unstructured notes.
